reviews.review_msg: I agree with the other reviews. Some of the other TCs had better FAs and thus did not have such a bad time as I did in the program. My biggest complaint is how Wendi gives no warning for half of the program changes and just forces you to go along with it, or she takes it out on you. Her feedback and lectures were not useful to my development.

A teaching degree like PDP is dictated by how lucky you are. If your SA or, in Wendi's case, FA, is no good, you will have a very rough time. My time with Wendi has not been good. I did not learn much from her, and she constantly made excuses for herself. She is critical of things that fall outside the BCTC standards.

It is baffling to me why SFU has people like Wendi in programs meant to mentor and help new and returning teachers. I already have teaching experience, and Wendi focused way too much on being an activist rather than ensuring my students' success. None of her feedback was meaningful and seemed like box-checking to please her. She was rude to me too.
